package rulefixtures

import "fmt"

// scenario for mixed_receiver_kinds: Methods on the same receiver type mix pointer and value receivers.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: consistency; severity: contextual.

type Counter struct {
	value int
	label string
}

func (c Counter) Read() int {
	return c.value
}

func (c *Counter) Increment() {
	c.value++
}

func (c Counter) String() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s=%d", c.label, c.value)
}

func (c *Counter) Reset() {
	c.value = 0
}
